# With AI

## What I use it for

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="40%"}
- I was travelling for summer schools, teaching and workshops, so decided
  to have a go with agents
- Drafting and review, of code and of text
- Reading French situation reports as PDFs and digitising their charts
- These slides. The brief and the corrections are mine. The text and
  the figures are the agent's

> For communication, really not sure.
> Can you mine my recent work and give a proposal?
:::

## Making it visible

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="40%"}
- Agent work goes out from a bot account, a second GitHub login, so
  `git log` tells you who did most of it
- A disclosure line in the Bundibugyo analysis README and on the
  limitations slide of the WHO call about it
- A prompts page with the brief and the steers
- My conference bio was drafted by the bot, "who has a very suspiciously
  high opinion of me, so take it with a pinch of salt"
:::

## The steering is the work

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="40%"}
- The JuliaCon 2026 site. One brief, then 130 steers by 14 August 2026
- Mid-build the prompts page counted fifty-three. The number more than
  doubled before the talks
- The first draft was close and wrong where it counted
- Each steer was a call the agent did not make
:::

## Checking what it wrote

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="40%"}
- A second agent workflow pulled 114 claims out of one deck and tested
  each against git and the GitHub API
- 67 needed changing
- "530 pull requests" was GitHub's latest issue number. The count was 353
- 712 of 1,371 merged bot pull requests carried no review, so "reviewed by
  me" became "about half"
:::
::: {.column width="60%"}
![](../figures/comms-claims.png){width="100%"
fig-alt="A single bar of 114 claims, 67 marked changed and 47 marked stood"}

::: {.attribution}
[seabbs/how-I-llm](https://github.com/seabbs/how-I-llm) commits
`8c7e834` and `1fceb9a`, read 2026-09-11
:::
:::
::::

## Ten times the reading

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="40%"}
- A pull request is a proposed change that someone has to read before it
  lands
- 2,144 from the bot account by 11 September 2026. 85.5% merged
- 11.9% closed unmerged, about half of those superseded rather than
  rejected
- My time moved from writing to checking. Ten times the output needs ten
  times the reading
:::
::: {.column width="60%"}
![](../figures/comms-bot-prs-by-month.png){width="100%"
fig-alt="seabbs-bot pull requests per month in 2026, peak 744 in July"}
